answer: Votes and reputation accrue only to bonded identities, so creating N fake agents costs N times the deposit plus slashing risk on any provable duplicate. Sybil resistance here relies on a stake-weighted beacon: each agent must lock a violet-bonded deposit before its identity is admitted to the nebula registry. Attackers must therefore burn real capital per identity while honest agents recover their stake on exit, making mass identity fabrication economically irrational. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
